**Finding 1 (high, correctness — baseline not captured before all plan-loading reads):** I moved the F009 fingerprint capture (`compute_fingerprint` + `record_baseline`) to the very top of `dispatch_volley` in `supervisor.py`, now executing *before* `sufficiency_gate.enforce_sufficiency_gate(plan_dir)` and `completion_gate.enforce_completion_gate(plan_dir)` — the two backstops that read `plan.md` and (when gated) feature/objective inputs into memory. The baseline therefore reflects true untouched dispatch-start disk state, so every later drift check compares against it and a pre-gate edit can no longer be silently baked into the baseline. The post-load dispatch-stage drift check is unchanged and still fires after `plan_loader.load`.
